articles.title_en: How to Sample and When to Stop Sampling: The Generalised Wald Problem and Minimax Policies
articles.title_cn: 如何采样以及何时停止采样：广义 Wald 问题和极小极大策略
articles.abstract_en: We study sequential experiments where sampling is costly and a decision-maker aims to determine the best treatment for full-scale implementation by (1) adaptively allocating units between two possible treatments, and (2) stopping the experiment when the expected welfare (inclusive of sampling costs) from implementing the chosen treatment is maximised. Working under a continuous time limit, we characterise the optimal policies under the minimax regret criterion. We show that the same policies also remain optimal under both parametric and non-parametric outcome distributions in an asymptotic regime where sampling costs approach zero. The minimax optimal sampling rule is just the Neyman allocation: it is independent of sampling costs and does not adapt to observed outcomes. The decision-maker halts sampling when the product of the average treatment difference and the number of observations surpasses a specific threshold. The results derived also apply to the so-called best-arm identification problem, where the number of observations is exogenously specified.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了抽样成本高昂的连续实验，决策者的目标是通过（1）在二种可能的治疗方法之间自适应地分配单位，并（2）在实施所选治疗方法的预期福利（包括抽样成本）最大化时停止实验，从而确定全面实施的最佳治疗方法。在连续时间限制下，我们描述了最小最大遗憾标准下的最优策略。我们表明，在采样成本接近零的渐进机制中，相同的策略在参数和非参数结果分布下也保持最优。极小极大最优抽样规则就是奈曼分配：它独立于抽样成本，并且不适应观察到的结果。当平均处理差异和观察数量的乘积超过特定阈值时，决策者停止采样。得出的结果也适用于所谓的最佳臂识别问题，其中观察数是外生指定的。

articles.title_en: Colluding Against Environmental Regulation
articles.title_cn: 串通环境监管
articles.abstract_en: We study collusion among firms against imperfectly monitored environmental regulation. Firms increase variable profits by violating regulation and reduce expected noncompliance penalties by violating jointly. We consider a case of three German automakers colluding to reduce the effectiveness of emissions control technology. By estimating a structural model of the European automobile industry from 2007 to 2018, we find that collusion lowers expected noncompliance penalties substantially and increases buyer and producer surplus. Due to increased pollution, welfare decreases by € 1.57–5.57 billion. We show how environmental policy design and antitrust play complementary roles in preventing noncompliance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业之间串通反对监管不完善的环境监管的情况。企业通过违反监管来增加可变利润，并通过联合违规来减少预期的违规处罚。我们考虑三德国汽车制造商串通降低排放控制技术有效性的案例。通过估计2007至2018欧洲汽车行业的结构模型，我们发现共谋大大降低了预期的违规处罚，并增加了买方和生产商剩余。由于污染加剧，福利减少了欧元1.57-5.57十亿。我们展示了环境政策设计和反垄断如何在防止违规行为方面发挥互补作用。

articles.title_en: Efficient Conservation of the Brazilian Amazon: Estimates from a Dynamic Model
articles.title_cn: 巴西亚马逊的有效保护：动态模型的估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the Brazilian Amazon’s carbon-efficient forest cover—i.e. when farmers internalize the social cost of carbon. We propose a dynamic discrete choice land-use model and estimate it using a panel of land use and carbon stock of 5.7 billion pixels between 2008 and 2017. The business-as-usual scenario implies an inefficient release of 42 billion tons of CO2 in the long run, resulting from the deforestation of an area twice the size of France. A carbon tax that makes farmers internalize the social cost of carbon would implement the efficient allocation and generate welfare gains exceeding 1.6 trillion dollars. Responses from a carbon tax are highly convex: a carbon tax of only $10/ton would preserve 95% of the efficient carbon stock. An excise tax on cattle ranching, a second-best policy, achieves at most 87% of the first-best welfare gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了巴西亚马逊地区的碳效率森林覆盖率，即当农民将碳的社会成本内部化时。我们提出了一个动态离散选择土地利用模型，并使用 5.7 和 2008 之间 2017 十亿 像素的土地利用和碳储量面板对其进行估计。一切照旧的情景意味着从长远来看，由于面积是法国两倍的森林砍伐，将导致42十亿吨二氧化碳的低效释放。碳税使农民将碳的社会成本内在化，从而实现有效分配并产生超过1.6万亿美元的福利收益。碳税的反应是高度凸的：仅$10/吨的碳税将保留95%的有效碳储量。对养牛场征收消费税是一项第二-最佳政策，最多可实现87%的第一-最佳福利收益。

articles.title_en: A Q-Theory of Banks
articles.title_cn: 银行的 Q 理论
articles.abstract_en: Bank capital requirements are based on book values, which are slow to reflect losses. In this article, we develop a dynamic model of banks to study the interaction of regulation and delayed accounting. Our model explains four stylized facts: book and market values diverge during crises, the market-to-book ratio predicts future profitability, book leverage constraints rarely bind strictly even as market leverage fans out during crises, and banks delever gradually after net-worth shocks. We show how delayed accounting can allow the regulator to achieve better outcomes than immediate (mark-to-market) accounting. In an estimated version of the model, the optimal regulation couples faster loan-loss recognition with a modest relaxation of the book leverage constraint.
articles.abstract_cn: 银行资本要求基于账面价值，反映损失的速度很慢。在本文中，我们开发了一个银行动态模型来研究监管和延迟会计的相互作用。我们的模型解释了四典型的事实：危机期间账面价值和市值出现分歧，市账率预测未来盈利能力，账面杠杆约束很少受到严格约束，即使市场杠杆在危机期间呈扇形扩散，银行在净值冲击后逐渐去杠杆化。我们展示了延迟会计如何让监管机构取得比即时（按市价）会计更好的结果。在模型的估计版本中，最优监管将更快的贷款损失确认与适度放宽账面杠杆约束相结合。

articles.title_en: The Economics and Econometrics of Gene–Environment Interplay
articles.title_cn: 基因与环境相互作用的经济学和计量经济学
articles.abstract_en: We discuss how to estimate the interplay between genes (nature) and environments (nurture), with an empirical illustration of the moderating effect of school starting age on one’s genetic predisposition towards educational attainment. We argue that gene–environment (G×E) studies can be instrumental for (i) assessing treatment effect heterogeneity, (ii) testing theoretical predictions, and (iii) uncovering mechanisms, thereby improving understanding of how (policy) interventions affect population subgroups. Empirically, we find that being old-for-grade and having a higher genetic propensity for education benefits children on assessment tests as they progress through school. In this setting, families appear to increase genetic inequalities while schools seem to reduce them.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们讨论如何估计基因（先天）和环境（后天）之间的相互作用，并通过实证说明入学年龄对 一 受教育程度的遗传倾向的调节作用。我们认为，基因-环境（G×E）研究有助于（i）评估治疗效果异质性，（ii）测试理论预测，以及（iii）揭示机制，从而增进对（政策）干预措施如何影响人口亚组的理解。根据经验，我们发现，年级较高且具有较高的教育遗传倾向有利于儿童在学校进步时进行评估测试。在这种情况下，家庭似乎加剧了遗传不平等，而学校似乎减少了遗传不平等。

articles.title_en: Global Value Chains and Trade Policy
articles.title_cn: 全球价值链和贸易政策
articles.abstract_en: How do global value chain (GVC) linkages modify countries’ incentives to impose import protection? Are these linkages important determinants of trade policy in practice? We develop a new approach to modelling tariff setting with GVCs, in which optimal policy depends on the nationality of value-added content embedded in home and foreign final goods. Theory predicts that discretionary tariffs will be decreasing in the domestic content of foreign-produced final goods and the foreign content of domestically produced final goods. Using data for 14 countries between 1995 and 2015, we show that governments set lower tariffs and curb their use of temporary trade barriers where GVC linkages are strongest, consistent with theory. Turning to quantitative model counterfactuals, we find that severing GVC linkages would lead to the disappearance of tariff preferences. Further, targeted policies to decouple China from GVCs would increase the optimal tariff set by G7 countries on Chinese exports.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球价值链 (GVC) 联系如何改变各国实施进口保护的动机？这些联系是实践中贸易政策的重要决定因素吗？我们开发了一种利用全球价值链对关税设定进行建模的新方法，其中最优政策取决于国内外最终产品中嵌入的增值内容的国籍。理论预测，酌情关税将随着外国生产的最终产品的国内含量和国内生产的最终产品的国外含量而下降。使用14和1995之间2015国家的数据，我们表明政府在全球价值链联系最强的地方设定了较低的关税并限制使用临时贸易壁垒，这与理论一致。转向定量模型反事实，我们发现切断全球价值链联系将导致关税优惠的消失。此外，使中国与全球价值链脱钩的有针对性的政策将提高七国集团国家对中国出口设定的最优关税。

articles.title_en: The U.S., Economic News, and the Global Financial Cycle
articles.title_cn: 美国、经济新闻和全球金融周期
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence for a causal link between the U.S. economy and the global financial cycle. Using intraday data, we show that U.S. macroeconomic news releases have large and significant effects on global risky asset prices. Stock price indexes of 27 countries, the VIX, and commodity prices all jump instantaneously upon news releases. The responses of stock indexes co-move across countries and are large—often comparable in size to the response of the S&P 500. Further, U.S. macroeconomic news explains on average 23% of the quarterly variation in foreign stock markets. The joint behaviour of stock prices, bond yields, and risk premia suggests that systematic U.S. monetary policy reactions to news do not drive the estimated effects. Instead, the evidence points to a direct effect on investors’ risk-taking capacity. Our findings show that a byproduct of the U.S.’s central position in the global financial system is that news about its business cycle has large effects on global financial conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了美国经济与全球金融周期之间因果关系的证据。利用日内数据，我们表明美国宏观经济新闻发布对全球风险资产价格具有巨大且显着的影响。 27国家的股票价格指数、波动率指数和大宗商品价格都会在新闻发布后立即上涨。股票指数的反应在不同国家之间共同变化并且很大——通常在规模上与标准普尔指数的反应相当500。此外，美国宏观经济新闻平均23%解释了外国股市的季度变化。股票价格、债券收益率和风险溢价的联合行为表明，美国货币政策对新闻的系统性反应并不会推动估计的影响。相反，有证据表明这对投资者的风险承担能力有直接影响。我们的研究结果表明，美国在全球金融体系中的中心地位的一个副产品是，有关其经济周期的新闻对全球金融状况有很大影响。

articles.title_en: How People Use Statistics
articles.title_cn: 人们如何使用统计数据
articles.abstract_en: For standard statistical problems, we provide new evidence documenting (1) multimodality and (2) instability in probability estimates, including from irrelevant changes in problem description. The evidence motivates a model in which, when solving a problem, people represent each hypothesis by attending to its salient features while neglecting other, potentially more relevant, ones. Only the statistics associated with salient features are used. The model unifies biases in judgments about i.i.d. draws, such as the Gambler's Fallacy and insensitivity to sample size, with biases in inference such as under- and overreaction and insensitivity to the weight of evidence. The model makes predictions for how changes in the salience of specific features jointly shapes known biases and measured attention to features, but also create entirely new biases. We test and confirm these predictions experimentally. Salience-driven attention to features emerges as a unifying framework for biases conventionally explained using a variety of stable heuristics or distortions of Bayes' rule.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于标准统计问题，我们提供了新的证据，记录了概率估计中的 (1) 多模态和 (2) 不稳定性，包括问题描述中不相关的变化。这些证据激发了一种模型，在该模型中，在解决问题时，人们通过关注其显着特征来表示每个假设，同时忽略其他可能更相关的特征。仅使用与显着特征相关的统计数据。该模型统一了独立同分布判断中的偏差。抽签，例如赌徒谬误和对样本大小不敏感，以及推理偏差，例如反应不足和过度反应以及对证据的重要性不敏感。该模型预测特定特征的显着性变化如何共同塑造已知的偏差和对特征的测量关注度，但也会产生全新的偏差。我们通过实验测试并证实这些预测。对特征的显着性驱动的关注成为一种统一框架，用于传统上使用各种稳定的启发式或贝叶斯规则的扭曲来解释的偏差。

articles.title_en: Barriers to Entry and Regional Economic Growth in China
articles.title_cn: 中国的进入壁垒和区域经济增长
articles.abstract_en: Labour productivity in manufacturing differs starkly across regions in China. We document that productivity, wages, and start-up rates of non-state firms have nevertheless experienced rapid unconditional regional convergence after 1995. To analyse these patterns, we construct a Hopenhayn model that incorporates location-specific capital wedges, output wedges, and entry barriers. Using Chinese Industry Census data, we estimate these wedges and examine their role in explaining differences in performance and growth across prefectures. Entry barriers explain most of the differences. We investigate the empirical covariates of these entry barriers and find that changes in barriers are causally related to changes in the size of the state sector: a smaller state sector leads to lower entry barriers.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国各地区制造业的劳动生产率存在明显差异。我们记录到，非国有企业的生产率、工资和开办率在1995之后经历了快速无条件的区域趋同。为了分析这些模式，我们构建了一个 Hopenhayn 模型，其中包含特定地点的资本楔子、输出楔子和进入壁垒。利用中国工业普查数据，我们估计了这些楔子，并检验了它们在解释各地区绩效和增长差异方面的作用。进入壁垒解释了大部分差异。我们研究了这些进入壁垒的实证协变量，发现壁垒的变化与国有部门规模的变化存在因果关系：国有部门规模较小导致进入壁垒较低。

articles.title_en: Trauma at School: The Impacts of Shootings on Students’ Human Capital and Economic Outcomes
articles.title_cn: 学校创伤：枪击事件对学生人力资本和经济成果的影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine how shootings at schools—an increasingly common form of gun violence in the States—impact the educational and economic trajectories of students. Using linked schooling and labor market data in Texas from 1992 to 2018, we compare within-student and across-cohort changes in outcomes following a shooting to those experienced by students at matched control schools. We find that school shootings increase absenteeism and grade repetition, reduce high school graduation, college enrollment, and college completion; and reduce employment and earnings at ages 24–26 years. We further find school-level increases in the number of leadership staff and reductions in retention among teachers and teaching support staff in the years following a shooting. The adverse impacts of shootings span student characteristics, suggesting that the economic costs of school shootings are universal.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了学校枪击事件（美国日益常见的枪支暴力形式）如何影响学生的教育和经济轨迹。我们利用德克萨斯州从1992到2018的相关学校教育和劳动力市场数据，将枪击事件后学生内部和跨群体的结果变化与匹配对照学校的学生所经历的结果进行比较。我们发现，学校枪击事件增加了缺勤率和留级率，降低了高中毕业率、大学入学率和大学毕业率；并减少 24-26 岁的就业和收入。我们进一步发现，在枪击事件发生后的几年里，学校层面的领导人员数量有所增加，而教师和教学支持人员的保留率却有所下降。枪击事件的不利影响跨越了学生的特征，这表明校园枪击事件的经济成本是普遍存在的。

articles.title_en: Identification and Inference in First-Price Auctions with Risk-Averse Bidders and Selective Entry
articles.title_cn: 第一-规避风险的投标人和选择性进入的价格拍卖中的识别和推理
articles.abstract_en: We study identification and inference in first-price auctions with risk-averse bidders and selective entry, building on a flexible framework we call the Affiliated Signal with Risk Aversion (AS-RA) model. Assuming exogenous variation in either the number of potential bidders (N) or a continuous instrument (z) shifting opportunity costs of entry, we provide a sharp characterization of the nonparametric restrictions implied by equilibrium bidding. This characterization implies that risk neutrality is nonparametrically testable. In addition, with sufficient variation in both N and z, the AS-RA model primitives are nonparametrically identified (up to a bounded constant) on their equilibrium domains. Finally, we explore new methods for inference in set-identified auction models based on Chen et al. (2018, Econometrica, vol. 86, 1965–2018), as well as novel and fast computational strategies using Mathematical Programming with Equilibrium Constraints. Simulation studies reveal the good finite-sample performance of our inference methods, which can readily be adapted to other set-identified flexible equilibrium models with parameter-dependent support.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有规避风险的投标人和选择性进入的第一价格拍卖中的识别和推理，建立在一个灵活的框架上，我们称之为风险规避附属信号（AS-RA）模型。假设潜在投标人数量 (N) 或连续工具 (z) 的外生变化改变了进入的机会成本，我们提供了均衡投标所隐含的非参数限制的清晰特征。这种特征意味着风险中性是不可参数测试的。此外，由于 N 和 z 都有足够的变化，AS-RA 模型基元在其平衡域上被非参数识别（最多有界常数）。最后，我们在 Chen 等人的基础上探索了集合识别拍卖模型的新推理方法。 （2018，计量经济学，第 86，1965-2018），以及使用具有平衡约束的数学规划的新颖且快速的计算策略。模拟研究揭示了我们的推理方法良好的有限样本性能，可以很容易地适应其他具有参数依赖支持的集合识别的灵活平衡模型。

articles.title_en: “Bad” Oil, “Worse” Oil, and Carbon Misallocation
articles.title_cn: “劣质”石油、“更差”石油和碳分配不当
articles.abstract_en: Not all barrels of oil are created equal: their extraction varies in both private cost and carbon intensity. Leveraging a comprehensive micro-dataset on world oil fields, alongside detailed estimates of carbon intensities and private extraction costs, this study quantifies the additional emissions and costs from having extracted the “wrong” deposits. We do so by comparing historical deposit-level supplies to counterfactuals that factor in pollution costs, while keeping annual global consumption unchanged. Between 1992 and 2018, carbon misallocation amounted to at least 11.00 gigatons of CO2-equivalent (GtCO2eq), incurring an environmental cost evaluated at $2.2 trillion (US$ 2018). This translates into a significant supply-side ecological debt for major producers of high-carbon oil. Looking forward, we estimate the gains from making deposit-level extraction socially optimal at about 9.30 GtCO2eq, valued at $1.9 trillion, along a future aggregate demand pathway coherent with the objective of net-zero emissions in 2050, and document unequal reserve stranding across oil nations.
articles.abstract_cn: 并非所有桶石油都是一样的：它们的开采在私人成本和碳强度方面都有所不同。这项研究利用世界油田的全面微观数据集，以及对碳强度和私人开采成本的详细估计，量化了因开采“错误”矿藏而产生的额外排放和成本。我们通过将历史存款水平供应与考虑污染成本的反事实进行比较，同时保持全球年度消费量不变来做到这一点。在1992和2018之间，碳分配不当至少达到11.00十亿吨二氧化碳当量（GtCO2eq），造成的环境成本估计为2.2万亿美元（2018美元）。这对于高碳石油的主要生产商来说意味着巨大的供应方生态债务。展望未来，我们估计，沿着与9.30净零排放目标相一致的未来总需求路径，使矿床水平开采在约1.9 GtCO2eq上达到社会最佳效益，价值为2050万亿美元，并记录石油国家之间不平等的储备搁浅。

articles.title_en: Creating Cohesive Communities: A Youth Camp Experiment in India
articles.title_cn: 创建有凝聚力的社区：印度的青年营实验
articles.abstract_en: Non-family-based institutions for socializing young people may play a vital role in creating close-knit, inclusive communities. We study the potential for youth camps—integrating rituals, sports, and civics training—to strengthen intergroup cohesion. We randomly assigned Hindu and Muslim adolescent boys, from West Bengal, India, to 2-week camps or to a pure control arm. To isolate mechanisms, we cross-randomized collective rituals (such as singing the national anthem, wearing uniforms, chanting support during matches, and synchronous dancing) and the intensity of intergroup contact. We find that camps reduce ingroup bias, increase willingness to interact with outgroup members, and enhance psychological well-being. Campers continue to have twice as many outgroup friends than control participants 1 year after the camps ended. Meanwhile, additional camp elements have heterogeneous effects: rituals have more positive impacts for the Hindu majority than the Muslim minority, while higher intergroup contact backfires among Hindus but not Muslims. Our findings demonstrate that inclusive youth camps may be a powerful tool for bridging deep social divides. Yet, we also highlight the conceptual challenges in crafting optimal integrative camps that help all groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 为年轻人提供社交服务的非家庭机构可能在创建紧密、包容的社区方面发挥着至关重要的作用。我们研究了青年营——整合仪式、体育和公民培训——增强群体间凝聚力的潜力。我们将来自印度西孟加拉邦的印度教和穆斯林青春期男孩随机分配到2周的营地或纯粹的对照组。为了隔离机制，我们交叉随机化了集体仪式（例如唱国歌、穿制服、比赛期间高呼支持、同步跳舞）和群体间接触的强度。我们发现营地减少了内群体偏见，增加了与外群体成员互动的意愿，并增强了心理健康。训练营结束一年后，营员的外群体朋友数量仍然是对照组参与者的两倍1。与此同时，额外的营地元素会产生异质性的影响：仪式对占多数的印度教徒比占少数的穆斯林有更积极的影响，而较高的群体间接触会适得其反，在印度教徒中而不是穆斯林中。我们的研究结果表明，包容性青年营可能是弥合深刻的社会分歧的有力工具。然而，我们也强调了打造帮助所有群体的最佳融合营地的概念挑战。

articles.title_en: Retractions: Updating from Complex Information
articles.title_cn: 撤回：从复杂信息中更新
articles.abstract_en: We modify a canonical experimental design to identify the effectiveness of retractions. Comparing beliefs after retractions to beliefs (1) without the retracted information and (2) after equivalent new information, we find that retractions result in diminished belief updating in both cases. We propose this reflects updating from retractions being more complex, and our analysis supports this: we find longer response times, lower accuracy, and higher variability. The results—robust across diverse participant groups and design variations—enhance our understanding of belief updating and offer insights into addressing misinformation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们修改了规范的实验设计来确定撤回的有效性。将撤回后的信念与没有撤回信息的信念（1）和同等新信息后的信念（2）进行比较，我们发现在这两种情况下撤回都会导致信念更新减少。我们认为这反映了撤回更新变得更加复杂，我们的分析支持了这一点：我们发现响应时间更长、准确性更低、可变性更高。结果在不同的参与者群体和设计变化中都很稳健，增强了我们对信念更新的理解，并为解决错误信息提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Unemployment Insurance Reforms and Labour Market Dynamics
articles.title_cn: 失业保险改革与劳动力市场动态
articles.abstract_en: A key question in labour market research is how the unemployment insurance system affects unemployment rates and labour market dynamics. We provide new answers to this old question by studying one of the largest unemployment insurance reforms in recent decades, the German Hartz reforms. On average, lower separation rates into unemployment account for 76% of declining unemployment after the reform, a fact unexplained by existing research focussing on job-finding rates. Exploiting institutional changes by age, employment duration, and wages, we establish a causal link between the reform and changes in labour market dynamics. Relying on the labour market theory, we generalize our empirical findings beyond the German case and establish separation rate changes as an important macroeconomic adjustment channel after unemployment insurance reforms. We derive analytically that the change of separation rates increases in proportion to average unemployment duration suggesting an equally important role for most other European labour markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场研究的一个关键问题是失业保险制度如何影响失业率和劳动力市场动态。我们通过研究近几十年来最大规模的失业保险改革——德国哈茨改革，为这个老问题提供了新的答案。平均而言，改革后失业率下降的原因是失业率下降76%，这一事实在关注就业率的现有研究中无法解释。利用年龄、就业期限和工资的制度变化，我们在改革与劳动力市场动态变化之间建立了因果关系。依托劳动力市场理论，我们将实证结果推广到德国案例之外，并将分离率变化确立为失业保险改革后重要的宏观经济调节渠道。我们分析得出，离职率的变化与平均失业持续时间成正比，这表明大多数其他欧洲劳动力市场也发挥着同样重要的作用。

articles.title_en: How Important Is Health Inequality for Lifetime Earnings Inequality?
articles.title_cn: 健康不平等对于终生收入不平等有多重要？
articles.abstract_en: Using a dynamic panel approach, we provide empirical evidence that negative health shocks significantly reduce earnings. The effect is primarily driven by the participation margin and is concentrated among the less educated and those in poor health. Next, we develop a life-cycle model of labour supply featuring risky and heterogeneous frailty profiles that affect individuals’ productivity, likelihood of access to social insurance, disutility from work, mortality, and medical expenses. Individuals can either work or not work and apply for social security disability insurance (SSDI/SSI). Eliminating health inequality in our model reduces the variance of log lifetime (accumulated) earnings by 28% at age 55. About 60% of this effect is due to the impact of poor health on the probability of obtaining SSDI/SSI benefits. Despite this, we show that eliminating the SSDI/SSI program reduces ex ante welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 使用动态面板方法，我们提供了经验证据，表明负面的健康冲击会显着降低收入。这种效应主要是由参与幅度驱动的，并且集中在受教育程度较低和健康状况不佳的人群中。接下来，我们开发了一个劳动力供应的生命周期模型，该模型具有风险和异质的脆弱性特征，影响个人的生产力、获得社会保险的可能性、工作负效用、死亡率和医疗费用。个人可以工作或不工作并申请社会保障残疾保险（SSDI/SSI）。消除我们模型中的健康不平等，可以将年龄 28% 时对数寿命（累积）收入的方差降低 55。这种影响的大约 60% 是由于健康状况不佳对获得 SSDI/SSI 福利的概率的影响。尽管如此，我们表明取消 SSDI/SSI 计划会降低事前福利。

articles.title_en: The Value of Privacy in Cartels: An Analysis of the Inner Workings of a Bidding Ring
articles.title_cn: 卡特尔中隐私的价值：投标环内部运作的分析
articles.abstract_en: We study how incentive constraints can be relaxed by randomization in a repeated-game setting. Our study is motivated by the workings of a detected bidding cartel that adopted a protocol of keeping the winning bid secret from the designated losers when defection was a concern. Keeping the winning bid secret makes accurately undercutting the winning bid more difficult and makes defection less attractive as potential defectors risk not winning the auction even if they deviate. We formalize these ideas in the context of a repeated-game setting and show that a cartel can attain higher payoffs by having the pre-selected winner randomize its bid and keep it secret from other members. Calibration of the model to the bid data of the cartel suggests that randomization may increase firms’ profits by about 56%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究如何通过重复游戏环境中的随机化来放松激励约束。我们的研究是受一个被发现的投标卡特尔运作的启发，该卡特尔采用了一项协议，当存在叛逃问题时，对指定的失败者保密中标投标。对中标竞价保密会使准确地削弱中标竞价变得更加困难，并且使叛逃者的吸引力降低，因为潜在的叛逃者即使偏离，也面临着无法赢得拍卖的风险。我们在重复博弈的背景下将这些想法形式化，并表明卡特尔可以通过让预先选定的获胜者随机化其出价并对其他成员保密来获得更高的回报。根据卡特尔的投标数据对模型进行校准表明，随机化可能会使公司的利润增加约56%。

articles.title_en: Pareto Improvements in the Contest for College Admissions
articles.title_cn: 大学招生竞赛中的帕累托改进
articles.abstract_en: Many countries base college admissions on a centrally administered test. Students invest a great deal of resources to improve their performance on the test, and there is growing concern about the high costs associated with these activities. We consider modifying the test by introducing performance-disclosure policies that pool intervals of performance rankings. Pooling affects the equilibrium allocation of students to colleges, which hurts some students and benefits others, but also affects students’ effort. We investigate how such policies can improve students’ welfare in a Pareto sense, study the Pareto frontier of pooling policies, and identify improvements that are robust to the distribution of college seats. We illustrate the potential applicability of our results with an empirical estimation that uses data on college admissions in Turkey. We find that a policy that pools a large fraction of the lowest-performing students leads to a Pareto improvement in a contest based on the estimated parameters. A laboratory experiment based on the estimated parameters generally supports our theoretical predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家的大学招生以集中管理的考试为基础。学生投入大量资源来提高考试成绩，人们越来越担心与这些活动相关的高成本。我们考虑通过引入绩效披露政策来修改测试，这些政策汇集了绩效排名的区间。汇集影响了学生到大学的均衡分配，对一些学生不利，对另一些学生有利，但也影响了学生的努力程度。我们研究这些政策如何在帕累托意义上改善学生的福利，研究汇集政策的帕累托前沿，并找出对大学席位分配强有力的改进措施。我们通过使用土耳其大学招生数据的实证估计来说明我们的结果的潜在适用性。我们发现，将大部分表现最差的学生集中在一起的政策会导致基于估计参数的竞赛出现帕累托改进。基于估计参数的实验室实验通常支持我们的理论预测。

articles.title_en: Attention Utility: Evidence from Individual Investors
articles.title_cn: 注意力效用：来自个人投资者的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study attention utility, the hedonic pleasure or pain derived purely from paying attention to information, which differs from the news utility that arises from gaining new information. The main, field, study examines brokerage account login data to show that investors pay disproportionate attention to already-known positive information on their stocks. Through its effect on logins, this selective attention affects their trading activity. Three experimental studies then show that (1) investors are more likely to engage in a paid task that will involve attention to a prior investment if that investment has gained value; (2) paying attention to a winning stock is more motivating than a doubling of monetary incentives; and that (3) attention has value independent of information acquisition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究注意力效用，即纯粹因关注信息而产生的享乐或痛苦，这与获得新信息所产生的新闻效用不同。这项主要领域的研究检查了经纪账户登录数据，结果表明投资者对其股票的已知积极信息给予了过多的关注。通过对登录的影响，这种选择性关注会影响他们的交易活动。 三实验研究表明，(1)投资者更有可能参与一项有偿任务，如果该投资已经获得了价值，那么该任务将涉及对先前投资的关注； (2) 关注获胜股票比加倍金钱激励更有激励作用；并且（3）注意力具有独立于信息获取的价值。

articles.title_en: Belief Identification by Proxy
articles.title_cn: 代理信念识别
articles.abstract_en: It is well-known that individual beliefs cannot be identified using traditional choice data, unless we exogenously assume state-independent utilities. In this paper, I propose a novel methodology that solves this long-standing identification problem in a simple way. This method relies on extending the state space by introducing a proxy, for which the agent has no stakes conditional on the original state space. The latter allows us to identify the agent’s conditional beliefs about the proxy given each state realization, which in turn suffices for indirectly identifying her beliefs about the original state space. This approach is analogous to the one of instrumental variables in econometrics. Similarly to instrumental variables, the appeal of this method comes from the flexibility in selecting a proxy.
articles.abstract_cn: 众所周知，除非我们外生地假设与状态无关的效用，否则无法使用传统的选择数据来识别个人信念。在本文中，我提出了一种新颖的方法，以简单的方式解决了这个长期存在的识别问题。该方法依赖于通过引入代理来扩展状态空间，代理在原始状态空间上没有任何利益条件。后者允许我们在给定每个状态实现的情况下识别代理对代理的条件信念，这反过来又足以间接识别她对原始状态空间的信念。这种方法类似于计量经济学中工具变量的一。与工具变量类似，这种方法的吸引力来自于选择代理的灵活性。
